parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain buying, app profitability and security concerns

claims.text: The user paid about 500 UAH to aunt Sveta to avoid large penalties from incorrectly marked columns in declarations.

Quarterly reports must be filed and taxes paid on time.
Mistakes often come from not checking which column to subtract which number.

topics.title: Profitability of a small app project

claims.text: Web platforms are the simplest but less profitable than Android/iOS.
Web SEO is poor; even on the 10th Google page the site is not found.
No external traffic sources (Instagram, X, Threads) or contextual ads are available.
User acquisition is almost zero because a paywall appears within the first 10 seconds.
Conversion is presumed zero; the product does not simplify anything or integrate with banks or tax cabinets.
Successful cases use fast delivery (<1 week) and cross‑platform stacks like Flutter, copying popular ideas with minor tweaks.
The discussed project likely targets LinkedIn audience, which now has fewer technical/managerial posts (<50%).
